summary: Each rank splits its local rows into disjoint GPU and CPU sets. Every timed iteration launches the GPU kernel over its row-map prefix and computes the CPU row list with complete CSR loops; after synchronization the GPU result is copied and mapped back into the full output before gather. Final SASS covers the GPU subset's row/nonzero work and store. The timed path processes GPU and CPU row sets on each requested pass. Compiled main has a counted GPU launch path through stub e790 and a counted GOMP path for spmvCpuRows; the actual outlined worker loops selected row IDs and each full CSR interval, computes products and stores the output. The full e790 stub calls cudaLaunchKernel. Final GPU SASS reaches its row-map kernel store.
